001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.economy;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.operation.Operation;
005import org.bukkit.World;
006import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
007import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
008
009import java.util.Deque;
010import java.util.List;
011
012public interface EconomyTransaction {
013
014  /**
015   * Checks this transaction can be finished
016   *
017   * @return The transaction can be finished (had enough money)
018   */
019  boolean checkBalance();
020
021  /**
022   * Commit the transaction
023   *
024   * @return The transaction success.
025   */
026  boolean commit();
027
028  /**
029   * Commit the transaction with callback
030   *
031   * @param callback The result callback
032   *
033   * @return The transaction success.
034   */
035  boolean commit(@NotNull TransactionCallback callback);
036
037  /**
038   * Commit the transaction by the Fail-Safe way Automatic rollback when commit failed
039   *
040   * @return The transaction success.
041   */
042  boolean failSafeCommit();
043
044  double getAmount();
045
046  void setAmount(double amount);
047
048  double getAmountAfterTax();
049
050  void setAmountAfterTax(double amountAfterTax);
051
052  @NotNull
053  EconomyCore getCore();
054
055  void setCore(@NotNull EconomyCore core);
056
057  @Nullable
058  String getCurrency();
059
060  void setCurrency(@Nullable String currency);
061
062  @Nullable
063  QUser getFrom();
064
065  void setFrom(@Nullable QUser from);
066
067  @Nullable
068  String getLastError();
069
070  void setLastError(@NotNull String lastError);
071
072  @NotNull
073  Deque<Operation> getProcessingStack();
074
075  /**
076   * Getting the tax in this transaction
077   *
078   * @return The tax in this transaction
079   */
080  double getTax();
081
082  void setTax(double tax);
083
084  @Nullable
085  QUser getTaxer();
086
087  void setTaxer(@Nullable QUser taxer);
088
089  @Nullable
090  QUser getTo();
091
092  void setTo(@Nullable QUser to);
093
094  @NotNull
095  World getWorld();
096
097  void setWorld(@NotNull World world);
098
099  /**
100   * Rolling back the transaction
101   *
102   * @param continueWhenFailed Continue when some parts of the rollback fails.
103   *
104   * @return A list contains all steps executed. If "continueWhenFailed" is false, it only contains
105   * all success steps before hit the error. Else all.
106   */
107  @SuppressWarnings("UnusedReturnValue")
108  @NotNull
109  List<Operation> rollback(boolean continueWhenFailed);
110
111  void setAllowLoan(boolean allowLoan);
112
113
114  interface TransactionCallback {
115
116    /**
117     * Calling while Transaction commit
118     *
119     * @param economyTransaction Transaction
120     *
121     * @return Does commit event has been cancelled
122     */
123    default boolean onCommit(@NotNull final EconomyTransaction economyTransaction) {
124
125      return true;
126    }
127
128    /**
129     * Calling while Transaction commit failed Use EconomyTransaction#getLastError() to getting
130     * reason Use EconomyTransaction#getSteps() to getting the fail step
131     *
132     * @param economyTransaction Transaction
133     */
134    default void onFailed(@NotNull final EconomyTransaction economyTransaction) {
135
136    }
137
138    /**
139     * Calling while Transaction commit successfully
140     *
141     * @param economyTransaction Transaction
142     */
143    default void onSuccess(@NotNull final EconomyTransaction economyTransaction) {
144
145    }
146
147    /**
148     * Calling while Tax processing failed Use EconomyTransaction#getLastError() to getting reason
149     * Use EconomyTransaction#getSteps() to getting the fail step
150     *
151     * @param economyTransaction Transaction
152     */
153    default void onTaxFailed(@NotNull final EconomyTransaction economyTransaction) {
154
155    }
156
157  }
158
159}
